_what_this_is: A RECOMPUTATION of the existing ledger, for cross-checking only. No entry was added, removed, re-weighted or re-dated.
rounding_note: the ledger's stored total is the sum of per-entry gpu_hours, each rounded at write time; recomputing from wall_seconds gives a value ~2e-6 h (about 8 ms) lower. Both are recorded; neither was altered.
ceiling: RETIRED (PI, 2026-10-10). The ledger remains a record; it caps nothing. Compute is gated by verified GPU availability instead.
